# Cracked Sky

> Cracked Sky is a 4-piece hard rock and grunge band from Manassas, Virginia. They cover 90s and 2000s alternative, grunge, and post-grunge rock. The band performs live across the Northern Virginia and DMV (DC-Maryland-Virginia) area.

## Genre
Hard Rock, Grunge, Post-Grunge, Alternative Rock

## Band Details
- Origin: Manassas, Virginia, USA
- Members: 4-piece band
- Era: 90s & 2000s Alternative, Grunge, Post-Grunge
- Repertoire: Covers of Alice in Chains, Pearl Jam, Soundgarden, Nirvana, Foo Fighters, Green Day, Weezer, Tool, Rage Against the Machine, Smashing Pumpkins, Bush, 3 Doors Down, Collective Soul, and more
